card.name: Partway through long words
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a longer word that is split into parts, such as the middle of a brand name, a political term or a place name. The next piece is still to come.

modes.label: Inside brand or drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of an uppercase drug name in a label heading.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS OMN<<ISC>>AN is contraindicated in patients

modes.label: Inside political or general words
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer word in general text, such as Democratic, Germany or Monarchies.

modes.label: Word before a following piece
modes.description: The word major, or a piece of it, appearing in or just after a split word.
